summary_en: The video provides a detailed guide on how to cook stuffed luffa and snail soup with Malabar spinach. A chef and a host introduce the ingredients, demonstrate how to prep snails and luffa, stuff the meat filling, prepare the broth, and complete the nutritious soup in a modern kitchen studio.
